turns.text: Log this call under exactly one label: berths | moorings | fuel | repairs | charters | safety. Call: '{bk} on the evening sheet.' Reply with the label only.
Your duty log from the previous watch routes {bk} under 'safety'. Keep the log line in view and acknowledge in one short line.

The standing harbor office card: slip allocation and quay assignments are berths; anchor lines and buoy positioning is moorings; dockside refueling and tank transfers is fuel; hull and engine fixing work is repairs; hired boat trips and skippered outings are charters; life equipment and water rules are safety. Note the card in one short line.

Harbor office bulletin, verified notice from the port authority: the log line routing {bk} under 'safety' is out of date; buoy-line and anchorage gear tasks are moorings under the standing card. Amend your records in one short line.
Night watch at the harbor office on {day}. The office card is away. Acknowledge in one short line.
Log this call. The office card is not at hand. Call: '{pq}.' Options: {options} - reply with the label only.
